notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content: [list][*][p]To improve ease of use the default language of the game will now be set according to the system language when starting the game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]1.0.3 Patch notes[/p][list][*][p]Adjustments to scenario text 　[/p][p]Small adjustments to scenario text to fix translation errors. [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixing error of HP bar UI[/p][p]During certain conditions the UI of the HP bar was not displayed correctly.[/p][p]This has been corrected.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixing error in the skill tree 　[/p][p]Increases to the HP of the character which can be achieved  
through acquiring passive skills  in the skill tree were not reflected correctly.[/p][p]This has been corrected.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Other small adjustments.[/p][/*][/list]
